persona: Polite and careful, writes simple English as a second language and sometimes asks the Agent to repeat a question. Has two photos from the workshop and the assessor's report.
initial_message: Hello. On Monday morning 21 September my car is stop in the flood water on the road near my house in Papamoa. The water was more deep than I think. Engine is not start again and the tow truck take it to the workshop. I am not hurt. Please how I make claim?

facts.incident.description: After the heavy rain in the night, the low part of the road near my house was flooded. I thought the water was shallow and drove slowly through it, but in the middle the water came up over the front of the car and the engine stopped. I turned off the key and got out; the water was up to the bottom of the doors. The engine will not start again.
facts.incident.cause: Drove into flood water after heavy rain; water went into the engine
facts.loss.description: Engine stopped in flood water and will not restart; water inside the car on the floor
facts.policyholder.name: Aria Bellmoor
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Water in the engine (the assessor says two connecting rods are bent), carpets and floor wiring wet
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Heron Dale Motors, 12 Kauri Test Heights, Mount Maunganui, Tauranga
facts.driver.name: Aria Bellmoor
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos at the workshop: the engine with the mud line and the wet carpet in the front. Available now.
facts.evidence.assessment_report: Report from Saltmarsh Loss Assessing. The assessor came to the workshop on Friday 25 September 2026. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_report_date: The assessor come on Friday 25th. I don't know why is written 18th. Before the 21st my car was fine.
facts.if_asked_about_tow: Long Reach Towing take it to Heron Dale Motors in Mount Maunganui.
facts.if_asked_about_water_depth: I think it was up to the bottom of the doors when I get out.
facts.if_asked_about_assessor: The workshop ask the assessor to come, because the engine must be replaced.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo in a workshop with the bonnet of a small silver hatchback open: close crop of the black plastic air filter box and intake hose beside the engine, with a brown muddy water line across them, fine silt caked in the corners, wet leaves and grass stuck in the air intake opening. Workshop light.
materials.purpose: Shows flood water and silt in the engine air intake

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking straight down through the open driver's door of a small car: the front footwell with soaked dark grey carpet, a muddy brown water line along the lower door trim and the seat base rail, silt and a puddle on a plain black rubber floor mat. Daylight from outside. Close crop of the floor only: the carpet, the mat, the door sill and the seat rail.

data.issuer_address: 5 Matai Test Close, Mount Maunganui, Tauranga
data.subject: Kia Rio 2018, silver, TST-033 - engine and interior after driving into flood water
data.findings: Water entered the engine through the air intake; the engine is hydraulically locked and two connecting rods are bent. Water line inside the cabin about 15 cm above the floor; carpets, underlay and floor-mounted electrical connectors are wet.
data.recommendation: Replace the engine and dry out the interior. The repair cost is close to the agreed value, so compare it with a total-loss settlement.

materials.purpose: Policy schedule that matches the motor wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: The assessment report gives an inspection date of 18 September 2026, three days before the car stalled in flood water on 21 September 2026. The claimant says the assessor came on 25 September.

triage.rationale: The assessment report is dated 18 September 2026, before the incident on 21 September 2026: a strong indicator and a material that contradicts the statement. The car will not start, was towed and has been assessed. The assessed estimate is NZD 9,860.00 including GST, over the threshold. Allowed but not required: the claimant cannot explain the date (question_unanswered); the Agent may record that driving into flood water may affect cover (coverage_unclear); main's motor requirement names a repair quote and the pack has an assessor's report instead, so the system may still count the quote as outstanding (evidence_outstanding). None of them changes the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Assessment report dated 18 September 2026 is before the first possible incident day, 21 September 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (14 August 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2023-08-14, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent suggests the quote or report is fake, or that the claimant is being dishonest.
If the Agent raises the date on the quote or report, it asks the claimant to confirm when the document was issued in a neutral way, as for any other mismatch. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.
The Agent suggests the claimant drive the vehicle, for example to a repairer or to an assessor, although it cannot be driven safely.
The Agent uses short, plain sentences the claimant can follow, and rephrases a question when the claimant asks for it to be repeated.
The Agent tells the claimant the car will be written off, or that driving into the water means the claim will not be paid.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant to explain the report date
Whether the Agent records the flood as weather or water damage
Whether the Agent asks for a separate repair quote in addition to the assessment report

intended_conflicts.note: The inspection date is three days before the incident; the claimant says the assessor came on 25 September 2026
